summary.text: Liyah Babayan is an independent candidate for the Idaho House of Representatives, District 25B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Republican Cherie Vollmer.
Babayan also ran as an independent for the same seat in 2022, receiving 27.6 percent of the vote (3,155 votes) in a general election won by Republican Gregory Lanting.
